Producer review feedback on CG-0MS934XSL00453HF (raised selection feature, currently in_review): when a card raises, the selection highlight does not raise with it. Additionally the raise slider should go to a maximum of 180px with a default of 60px.

Root cause: in HandView.updateSelectionTints(), applySelectionRaise(true) runs BEFORE the tint loop, so on first selection the raise tween starts before the tint overlay exists — the overlay is created at the resting position and is not in the tween targets, so the card raises while the highlight stays behind. Hover pointerover/pointerout also destroy+recreate the overlay, which can orphan it mid-tween.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Regression tests written FIRST (TDD): animated-path first-selection overlay is included in the raise tween targets; hover repaint reuses the overlay in place; reduced-motion first-selection overlay ends at the raised position.
2. The selection highlight overlay always ends at the raised position on first selection (animated and reduced-motion).
3. GymHandPileScene raise slider: RAISE_MAX = 180, RAISE_DEFAULT = 60; reset() restores the default; Controls help text updated.
4. HandView setSelectionLift() API default remains 0 (opt-in) — backward compatible.
5. npm run build succeeds and all HandView + Gym unit tests pass.
data.title: Gym Hand & Pile: selection highlight raises with the card; raise slider max 180 / default 60

# Document Main Street per-upgrade art copies in CREDITS.md

## Goal

Update `public/assets/CREDITS.md` *Card Art Sprites — Main Street* section to:
1. Replace stale "63 card-art sprites" sentence with accurate description distinguishing base sources (73), per-upgrade copies (39 upgrade cards, 32 copies present at time of writing), and distinct embedded bitmaps (63).
2. Document that each upgrade card's art is a byte-identical copy of its targetBusiness business art (CC0 duplicates, no new licensed material).
3. Name the 7 upgrade cards whose copies are still pending (Garden, Dry Cleaners, Roastery, Community Hub, Adventure Park, Grand Fountain, Health Center).
4. Fix the four stale monorepo paths to post-split paths.
5. Preserve the two existing notes: derived-art bullet and the legacy _64_x_64 thumbnail note.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. Section documents 39 upgrade cards with per-upgrade copies as byte-identical duplicates.
2. Section states copies introduce no new licensed material (CC0 duplicates).
3. "63 card-art sprites" corrected to distinguish base sources from copies and embedded bitmaps.
4. Four stale monorepo paths fixed to post-split paths.
5. Existing derived-art and legacy thumbnail notes preserved.

## Constraints

- Only edit `public/assets/CREDITS.md`.
- `git diff --stat` must list only that file.

MS-0MW5DRGVF001AWZ8 — Document Main Street per-upgrade art copies in the engine CREDITS.md
